name: Sohail Afzal Choudhry
story: Sohail Afzal Choudhry’s 1998 University of Waikato doctoral research on the Kaimai hydropower project catchment provides a detailed New Zealand example. The work combined surface hydrological modelling with GIS and spatial time-series databases. ARC/INFO and ArcView were used alongside object-oriented programming and dynamic segmentation techniques. The research integrated catchment mapping, modelling and spatial time-series data within the same workflow.
